nights.title: Die Spitz
nights.name: Die Spitz
nights.extract: Die Spitz is an American rock band from Austin, Texas, consisting of guitarist/singer/drummer Ava Schrobilgen, guitarist/singer Eleanor Livingston, bassist Kate Halter, and drummer/singer/guitarist Chloe de St. Aubin. Their debut album Something to Consume was released in September 2025.
